PatternRow.description: One pad's steps. `steps` holds exactly the pattern's length of velocities from 0 (no hit) to 1.

pad.description: The pad's id in the kit format.

steps.description: Velocity per step, 0 for no hit.

description: A step sequencer pattern as a file of its own: a grid of pads against steps, with a velocity per cell. Pads are named by the ids the kit format uses (`kick`, `snare`, `hh-closed`…), so the pattern plays on any kit with those pads.

length.description: Steps in the pattern, which loops after the last.

rows.description: One row per pad that has hits.

stepsPerBeat.description: Steps per quarter note: 2 for eighths, 4 for sixteenths, 8 for thirty-seconds; 3 and 6 for triplets.

swing.description: 0 is straight; 1 delays every second step by a third of a step, a triplet feel.

title: Cantina drum pattern
